items.source: OFFICIAL ibkr.com metals commissions page (fetched, quoted from raw HTML)
items.value: London Gold, US Spot Gold - Tiered, by Order Amount (USD): 0-500,000 => 1.5 bps * Trade Value; 500,000.01-1,000,000 => 1.0 bps; > 1,000,000 => 0.7 bps. Minimum Per Order: Tier 1 USD 2.00 (Tiers 2 and 3: N/A). Notes: '1 basis point=0.0001', 'Commissions apply to all order types.', 'All exchange and regulatory fees included.', modified orders treated as cancel+replace. Worked example on page: buy 500 oz XAUUSD @ USD 1900 => execution fee USD 120.
items.distinction: STATED-FEE. Simulated (paper) fills will realize commission rules but NOT prove them; measured-live-execution verification = commission line in real account reporting (owner scope, out of probe).
items.instrument_warning: page covers BOTH 'London Gold, US Spot Gold' (same tier table) and USGOLD (US-only OTC retail product). The probe instrument is London Gold XAUUSD CMDTY; USGOLD residency restrictions (not available in AZ, MT, NH, RI) do not apply to it.

items.value: 'London Gold, London Silver - Storage cost 0.10% per annum.' Page example: storage fee = (1900*500*0.1%/360) = USD 2.64 per day (annualized, /360 day-count). Corroborated by IBKR (IE) page: 'Unallocated Carrying Fee of 10 basis points charged for storage. Settlement is T+2.'
items.distinction: STATED-FEE on notional; accrues only while a LONG position is held overnight - the probe takes no positions, so this is schedule evidence only
items.comparison_only: USGOLD storage is USD 0.15 per ounce per month - DIFFERENT product, do not mix

items.source: OFFICIAL ibkr.com metals commissions page (Borrow Fees table) + OFFICIAL ibkr.ie metals page
items.classification: STATED-FEE (tiered, benchmark-linked; benchmark value moves daily)
items.value: Balance cutoffs (USD): 0-1,000,000 => 4.63% (BM + 1%); 1,000,000.01-10,000,000 => 4.13% (BM + 0.5%); > 10,000,000 => 3.93% (BM + 0.3%). Page states these assume Benchmark USD = 5.08% (page snapshot value, NOT a live quote). Worked example: shortsell 500 oz XAUUSD @ 1900 => Borrow Fee = (1900*500*(5.08+1)%/360) = USD 160.44 per day.
items.distinction: STATED-FEE as of retrieval 2026-09-16; the BM component floats with the USD benchmark rate, so any forward cost model must carry BM as an input, not the snapshot 5.08%
items.prohibition_note: short-side rates are schedule evidence only; the probe never opens a short

items.value: simulated (paper) fills are NOT live slippage and carry ZERO evidential weight for execution cost. Paper fills realize stated commissions and simulated spread crossing, but they do not observe real queue/liquidity. Any paper-fill-derived number must be labeled 'simulated' and may never be merged into, or presented as, measured-live-execution cost evidence.
